priorWorkflow:
name: Isolated Android axis refusal host test
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      profile:
        description: Exact root-selected isolated host profile
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - axis-refusal-host-v1
      root_selection:
        description: Root-selected JSON from the delivered false/unbound template
        required: true
        type: string
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: android-axis-refusal-host
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  axis-refusal:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.run_attempt == 1
    runs-on: macos-15
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      DEVELOPER_DIR: /Applications/Xcode_26.3.app/Contents/Developer
      TOOLCHAINS: com.apple.dt.toolchain.XcodeDefault
      MIXER_AXIS_ROOT_SELECTION: ${{ inputs.root_selection }}
      MIXER_AXIS_PROFILE: ${{ inputs.profile }}
      MIXER_AXIS_OUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/android-axis-refusal-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        timeout-minutes: 3
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /.github/workflows/android-axis-refusal-host.yml
            /scripts/ci/verify-apple-toolchain.py
            /verification/android-axis-refusal-host-preparation/
            /verification/android-axis-refusal-host-review/receipt.json
            /verification/android-axis-refusal-host-admission-result-correction/
      - name: Exact root binding and 27 source members
        timeout-minutes: 2
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ulimit -f 65536
          node --input-type=module - <<'NODE'
          import {preflight} from './verification/android-axis-refusal-host-admission-result-correction/verify.mjs';
          const e=process.env;
          await preflight({root:e.GITHUB_WORKSPACE,outputDirectory:e.MIXER_AXIS_OUT,selection:JSON.parse(e.MIXER_AXIS_ROOT_SELECTION),context:{repository:e.GITHUB_REPOSITORY,sha:e.GITHUB_SHA,event:e.GITHUB_EVENT_NAME,profile:e.MIXER_AXIS_PROFILE,run_id:e.GITHUB_RUN_ID,run_attempt:e.GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT,node_version:process.version}});
          NODE
      - name: Existing exact Apple toolchain verifier
        timeout-minutes: 3
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ulimit -f 65536
          ulimit -f > "$MIXER_AXIS_OUT/apple-bash-file-limit-blocks.txt"
          export MIXER_AXIS_BASH_VERSION="$BASH_VERSION"
          MIXER_AXIS_LIMIT_PREFIX=apple- python3 -B verification/android-axis-refusal-host-admission-result-correction/verify-file-limit.py \
            > "$MIXER_AXIS_OUT/apple-file-limit.stdout" 2> "$MIXER_AXIS_OUT/apple-file-limit.stderr"
          python3 -B scripts/ci/verify-apple-toolchain.py \
            --developer-dir "$DEVELOPER_DIR" --xcode-version 26.3 --xcode-build 17C529 \
            --output "$MIXER_AXIS_OUT/apple-toolchain.json" \
            > "$MIXER_AXIS_OUT/apple-toolchain.stdout" 2> "$MIXER_AXIS_OUT/apple-toolchain.stderr"
      - name: One unfiltered isolated SwiftPM test command
        timeout-minutes: 12
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ulimit -f 65536
          ulimit -f > "$MIXER_AXIS_OUT/bash-file-limit-blocks.txt"
          export MIXER_AXIS_BASH_VERSION="$BASH_VERSION"
          python3 -B verification/android-axis-refusal-host-admission-result-correction/verify-file-limit.py \
            > "$MIXER_AXIS_OUT/file-limit.stdout" 2> "$MIXER_AXIS_OUT/file-limit.stderr"
          node --input-type=module - <<'NODE'
          import {recordCommand} from './verification/android-axis-refusal-host-admission-result-correction/verify.mjs';
          const e=process.env;
          await recordCommand({workspace:e.GITHUB_WORKSPACE,runnerTemp:e.RUNNER_TEMP,outputDirectory:e.MIXER_AXIS_OUT,context:{run_id:e.GITHUB_RUN_ID},bashVersion:e.MIXER_AXIS_BASH_VERSION});
          NODE
          MIXER_AXIS_SCRATCH="$RUNNER_TEMP/android-axis-refusal-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-1-scratch"
          test ! -e "$MIXER_AXIS_SCRATCH"
          set +e
          "$DEVELOPER_DIR/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/bin/swift" test \
            --package-path "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/verification/android-axis-refusal-host-preparation/package" \
            --scratch-path "$MIXER_AXIS_SCRATCH" --jobs 2 \
            > "$MIXER_AXIS_OUT/swift.stdout" 2> "$MIXER_AXIS_OUT/swift.stderr"
          MIXER_AXIS_EXIT="$?"
          set -e
          export MIXER_AXIS_EXIT
          node --input-type=module - <<'NODE'
          import {recordCommand} from './verification/android-axis-refusal-host-admission-result-correction/verify.mjs';
          const e=process.env;
          await recordCommand({workspace:e.GITHUB_WORKSPACE,runnerTemp:e.RUNNER_TEMP,outputDirectory:e.MIXER_AXIS_OUT,context:{run_id:e.GITHUB_RUN_ID},bashVersion:e.MIXER_AXIS_BASH_VERSION,exitCode:Number(e.MIXER_AXIS_EXIT)});
          NODE
          exit "$MIXER_AXIS_EXIT"
      - name: Preserve all 27 postflight source identities
        if: always()
        timeout-minutes: 2
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ulimit -f 65536
          node --input-type=module - <<'NODE'
          import {postflight} from './verification/android-axis-refusal-host-admission-result-correction/verify.mjs';
          await postflight({root:process.env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE,outputDirectory:process.env.MIXER_AXIS_OUT});
          NODE
      - name: Require every named result and both framework summaries
        if: always()
        timeout-minutes: 2
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ulimit -f 65536
          node --input-type=module - <<'NODE'
          import {assess} from './verification/android-axis-refusal-host-admission-result-correction/verify.mjs';
          await assess({root:process.env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE,outputDirectory:process.env.MIXER_AXIS_OUT});
          NODE
      - name: Retain successful or failed evidence
        if: always()
        timeout-minutes: 3
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: android-axis-refusal-host-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/android-axis-refusal-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/

template.authority_note: Mechanism/bounds coordinated with root; no workflow installation or dispatch authority is granted here. Root binds the delivered source revision after push and passes this selected JSON as data in the sole manual workflow_dispatch input. This avoids a self-referential committed revision. A null run_id permits recording the root-dispatched first run; actual run identity and single-dispatch allowance consumption must be reconciled by root result review. Workflow conditions cannot prove only one manual dispatch ever occurred.
